edit_instruction: Make the weighted training ball blue while preserving its shape, texture, lighting, and background.

primitives.edit_description: change the weighted training ball from black to vivid blue

questions.question: Considering only the requested color change, which description best matches the weighted training ball's current visible color?
stages: the ball retains its original black appearance
the ball remains mostly black with an emerging blue tint
the ball shows a clearly mixed black and blue appearance
the ball appears predominantly blue with residual dark areas
the ball shows the full vivid blue appearance of the target

questions.question: Considering only the ball, which description best matches the visible evidence of its original dark appearance?
stages: the original black appearance dominates the ball
most of the ball remains black while blue begins to emerge
dark and blue appearances are both visibly substantial
only limited dark traces remain on a mostly blue ball
no meaningful original black appearance remains on the target-blue ball

questions.question: Considering only the ball, which description best matches how visibly established the requested vivid blue appearance is?
stages: the requested blue appearance is absent and the ball is black
a faint blue appearance is visible but black still dominates
blue and the original dark appearance are comparably established
blue dominates but has not reached the full target vividness
the vivid target-blue appearance is fully established

preserve_constraints: ball surface texture and embossed lettering
